title: Pre-Contact Canary Discipline Gate
summary: Implement a mandatory pre-contact canary discipline gate in the MCP bridge remote-runner start path. Immediately before contacting the runner start endpoint, the bridge now records a local non-target-workspace pre-contact canary discipline artifact under the bridge .local directory. The artifact records a process-tree/process snapshot, abort-readiness, no-retry marker, no-chaining marker, target workspace cleanliness, and approval/clearance freshness at contact time. If the discipline artifact is not valid, the start path returns before runner contact with PRE_CONTACT_CANARY_DISCIPLINE_FAILED. The artifact is written outside the ForgePilot target workspace so it does not dirty the workspace before runner validation. The start request now carries preContactCanaryDiscipline metadata and boundaryVersion FP-MCP-240. Verification passed with pnpm test, including TypeScript build and hardcoded packet-id lint. Bridge commit 1d906c3 records the implementation.
caveats: This implementation changes the start path but has not yet been exercised by a fresh real guarded start.

The pre-contact discipline artifact is local to the MCP bridge .local directory to avoid dirtying the ForgePilot target workspace before runner validation; a later output-promotion or run-result reader packet may make these artifacts easier to collect into canonical run evidence.
The process snapshot is bounded and filtered to relevant process lines; it is a practical guard artifact, not a full forensic process dump.
Abort-readiness records that AbortController exists and the 10-second timeout policy is armed before contact; it does not by itself prove an operator can manually abort after contact.
No retry/no-chaining are recorded as explicit state markers for the single start call path; future multi-attempt orchestration would require separate policy and tooling.
The MCP service must be restarted before FP-MCP-240 is active in the live runtime.

motivation.sourceGap: FP-MCP-237 found that FP-MCP-233 did not sufficiently evidence process-tree snapshot, live abort-readiness, no-retry, and no-chaining at the actual first start contact boundary.
motivation.policyObjective: A future fresh guarded start must not contact the runner start endpoint unless the pre-contact discipline evidence is recorded and valid.
